_doc: Initial coefficients of DESIGN.md section 4 (uncalibrated priors). Loaded by report/y700_battery/config.py: the package copy is /usr/local/share/y700-battery/coeffs-v1.json; a calibrated ~/.config/y700-battery/coeffs-v<N>.json with the highest N wins. Every entry has value, unit, src, date, ci95 (null = not measured). Keys starting with _ are comments.

F_on.src: 续航速查：旋钮全关时的熄屏底噪 0.33 W；cx-auto 只在熄屏且用电池时才开，亮屏底噪按这个算（BATTERY-PAGE:53）

F_off.src: 先验：让 F_off + A*(1-exp(-R/R0)) 在平静时 R=150/s 下复现 E3a 平静的约 0.25 W：0.25 W - 103 mW = 147 mW（DESIGN 第 4 节表格写「约 120 mW / 取整约 120-150」，这里取推导值；以标定 B1 为准）

D_on.src: y7/y9 配对：亮屏额外 0.5-0.7 W

B.unit: piecewise linear [backlight level 0-4095, mW]; clamp outside the points

Pmax_little.unit: mW per busy core at fmax_little (cpu0-5, cpufreq policy0)

Pmax_big.unit: mW per busy core at fmax_big (cpu6-7, cpufreq policy6)

Pg.unit: mW of GPU busy time at g_fref_mhz
